## Summary

Describe the problem and the proposed change.

## Detection impact

- [ ] No detection behaviour changes
- [ ] Adds or changes a high-confidence signal
- [ ] Changes false-positive or false-negative trade-offs

Explain any checked detection change and include both positive and negative
test cases.

## Verification

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] `python -m compileall -q src tests`
- [ ] Documentation is updated when behaviour changes
- [ ] No credentials, private logs, or generated reports are included
